title: Network diagnostics
description: Check the network on the device running the Yuhaiin core. Each result includes its scope and evidence.
targetHint: Enter a hostname without a URL, port or path. Checks contact this host on HTTPS port 443 and Cloudflare DNS addresses for direct IP connectivity.
progress: Checking TUN, DNS, IP connectivity, routing and the selected TCP node. Usually completes within 6 seconds.
interrupted: Diagnosis was canceled or exceeded the waiting time. Run it again when ready.
alreadyRunning: Another diagnosis is running on this core. Try again after it finishes.
invalidHost: Enter a DNS hostname, such as www.cloudflare.com, without a scheme, port or path.
unavailable: This backend does not have the diagnostics service. Update the backend and try again.
requestFailed: Could not get a diagnosis report from the backend. Check the API connection and authentication.
privacy: The report includes the target, DNS answers, routing labels and TUN counters. Node configurations, credentials and raw logs are excluded. Review it before sharing.

messages.ipv6_disabled: IPv6 is disabled in the core settings.
messages.no_selected_node: No TCP node is selected. Routing may still use a direct or tagged outbound.
messages.probe_failed: The probe failed. Raw errors are kept out of the report to protect node credentials.
messages.no_tun: No TUN is configured. This can be expected when using a proxy inbound.
messages.tun_not_running: An enabled TUN has no registered listener. Check startup logs and device permissions.
messages.tun_capture_unverified: The TUN listener is registered. Counters show ingress since startup; current system capture and forwarding still need verification.
messages.no_dns_records: No address records were returned for this family. This alone does not prove DNS failure.
messages.dns_resolved: Real addresses were returned through the configured resolver/hosts path; cached answers may be used.
messages.tcp_connected: The core connected directly to this IP on TCP port 443 without resolving the target hostname.
messages.https_response: TLS verification succeeded and an HTTP response was received. The HTTP status is shown below.
messages.route_matched: The target matched this route. Inbound- or process-specific rules may choose differently for an actual app.
messages.route_blocks_target: The target matches a blocking rule; verify whether this is intended.
messages.tls_verification_failed: TLS certificate verification failed. Check the target certificate, clock and TLS interception.
messages.network_unreachable: The network or host is unreachable.
messages.dns_failed: A DNS lookup failed while establishing this connection.
messages.route_selected_node: The target routes through the selected TCP node. Actual app traffic may differ by inbound/process rules.

findingsText.check_tun_start: An enabled TUN has no registered listener. Check startup errors, VPN/device permissions and whether the inbound was applied.
findingsText.check_dns: Configured DNS probes failed. Inspect the resolver and its outbound/routing policy; compare with the direct IP probes.
findingsText.ipv4_path_failed: The IPv4 control endpoint failed while IPv6 connected. Check the IPv4 underlay; one endpoint is not a verdict for all IPv4 traffic.
findingsText.ipv6_path_failed: The IPv6 control endpoint failed while IPv4 connected. Check IPv6 addresses, upstream access and routes; compare another destination.
findingsText.check_route_block: The tested target is blocked by the routing policy. Review the match evidence and whether blocking is intended.
findingsText.check_selected_node: The selected TCP node could not complete HTTPS to this target. Compare another node and destination before attributing a node fault.
findingsText.check_route_path: The selected TCP node probe passed but the routed HTTPS probe failed. Inspect the matched route, resolver, hosts mapping and tagged outbound.
findingsText.core_path_works: The core completed routed HTTPS to this target. If applications still fail, check TUN capture, system routing, app DNS and process/inbound rules.
findingsText.scope_limit: These checks run on the backend device and cover one target. OS routes, current TUN forwarding, browser DNS, UDP and other destinations need separate confirmation.
findingsText.check_dns4: The configured A lookup failed while AAAA resolved. Inspect A-record queries and resolver policy.
findingsText.check_dns6: The configured AAAA lookup failed while A resolved. Inspect AAAA-record queries and resolver policy.
findingsText.check_direct_path: Direct IP control probes did not connect. Check interface binding, underlying connectivity and endpoint restrictions; proxy paths may still work.
findingsText.select_tcp_node: Routing requires a selected TCP node, but none is selected. Select a node or choose a direct/tagged route for this target.
findingsText.check_routed_https: Routed HTTPS failed for this target. Compare DNS and route evidence, check the error category, and retry another destination.

tcp.title: TCP stack diagnostics
tcp.description: On-demand, bounded snapshots of lightweight TCP stacks. No packet capture or background polling.
tcp.failed: Could not read TCP stack diagnostics. Check the backend and your permissions.
tcp.empty: No active lightweight inbound stack supports diagnostics.
tcp.privacy: This read-only sample contains IP addresses and port numbers. It shows up to 32 TCP flows per stack and 32 UDP sessions per node, without packet contents. Review before sharing.
tcp.globalDescription: One on-demand snapshot across connections, inbounds, active outbound nodes and observable TCP stacks.
tcp.snapshotHint: Capture a snapshot to load existing counters. This does not start VPN sessions or run network tests.
tcp.globalTrafficScope: Global byte totals come from the connection monitor. These are application payload bytes, not encrypted wire bytes.
tcp.noDoubleCount: Stack retransmissions and drops cover only displayed lightweight stacks. Inbound and outbound figures may observe the same traffic and are never added together.
tcp.inboundsHint: Ingress counters are cumulative and represent admitted requests, not confirmed forwarding.
tcp.outboundsHint: Only active/selected nodes are queried (up to 100); node byte counters are per-hop and are not added to global traffic. Native VPN state is separate from TCP RTT.
tcp.noOutbounds: No active or selected outbound nodes were observed.
tcp.truncatedNodes: Node observations are limited to the first 100 active/selected nodes.
tcp.unsupportedStack: No lightweight TCP stack metrics available for this instance. Native state and generic counters may still be available.
tcp.udpSessionHelp: Sessions from the connection list for this node. A session can serve multiple targets; the target shown was recorded when it opened. Counts may differ from node counters in proxy chains.
tcp.noUdpSessions: No UDP sessions for this node in this snapshot.
tcp.unavailableStack: TCP stack snapshot unavailable (requires updated backend and diagnostics permission).
tcp.unavailableTraffic: Global traffic totals unavailable (connections:read permission required).
tcp.unavailableOutbounds: Outbound node list unavailable (nodes:read permission required).
tcp.unavailableNodeStatus: Outbound runtime status unavailable (nodes:read permission required).
tcp.selectItem: Select an item to see its details.
tcp.deltaHint: From the second snapshot on, +N shows growth since the previous one and total speed is averaged over that interval.
